msg.sender is fed into the keccak256 randomness source.
onlyAdmin gate compares msg.sender to adminAddress.
onlyAdmin gate compares msg.sender to adminAddress.

block.timestamp is used as a randomness seed.
timestamp feeds the weak randomness operation.

getPrice reads saleStartTime for elapsed computation.
mint calls getPrice.

Plot id argument is only used inside transmuteChromaNFT.
Count argument is only used inside transmuteChromaNFT.
Price argument only configures the sale in startRelease.
Duration argument only configures the sale in startRelease.
New admin argument is only assigned inside setAdmin.
